purpose: Teach: 主席/報復/紫外線/盗聴/衰え/反抗/自閉症/射撃

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、入社試験は主席を見極めろ
lines.en: Our entry examination needs to identify top performers with leadership potential.
lines.style: Authoritative, measured delivery. Clipped pace, no hesitation. The tone of someone used to being heard. Eyes steady, posture straight.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。競合への報復ではなく、独自路線で勝負します
lines.en: Yes. We won't retaliate against competitors—we'll compete on our own unique terms.
lines.style: Respectful but confident. Light emphasis on the pivot point. Clear, deliberate pace. Showing both deference and conviction without contradiction.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、紫外線カット製品の開発を急げ
lines.en: Accelerate development of our UV-blocking product line before the window closes.
lines.style: Direct, urgent undertone without urgency in delivery. Measured but firm. The instruction of someone who sees what others miss. No softening.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。社内の盗聴対策を強化しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently reinforcing our internal security protocols against corporate surveillance.
lines.style: Steady update-tone. Professional completeness—covering all points without overexplaining. Measured pace. The voice of someone on top of his responsibilities.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 業界が衰える前に新事業を立ち上げろ
lines.en: We need to launch new ventures before this industry starts its decline.
lines.style: Clear-eyed urgency. Not rushed, but weighted with consequence. Slight emphasis on 'new'—marking the pivot. The tone of foresight, not panic.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。お得意様の反抗的なお声にも丁寧に対応します
lines.en: Yes. Even when key clients express pushback, we're handling it with respect and professionalism.
lines.style: Calm, detail-conscious delivery. Showing attentiveness to client relations without defensive tone. Steady rhythm. The voice of someone managing multiple stakeholder concerns.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 当社、自閉症の方向けの商品開発も検討しろ
lines.en: We should also explore product development initiatives aimed at the autism community.
lines.style: Measured, considered. Opens with slight weight—signaling the importance of inclusion. No rush. The tone of someone expanding scope thoughtfully, not checking a box.

lines.speaker: kenji_office
lines.jp: はい。射撃用品の販売も検討しております
lines.en: Yes. We're currently examining the feasibility of expanding into sporting goods retail.
lines.style: Professional closing statement. Even, complete. The final update—confirming all fronts are covered. Clear enunciation, calm finality without abruptness.
